patch.value: SDK entrypoint import-cost gate false-fails on cold filesystem cache: single-shot fresh-process sampling exceeds the 30ms noise margin

Live reproduction 2026-07-26 on clean main (2026.7.26): the first pnpm lint invocation of the day failed the SDK entrypoint import-cost gate with './sdk/runtime: 545ms > 510ms' (budget 480ms + LATENCY_NOISE_MARGIN_MS 30). An immediate re-run with zero code or environment changes passed all 10 entrypoints, and every subsequent run stayed green. The gate spawns fresh Node processes per entrypoint but takes a single timing sample per check run, so a cold filesystem/module cache on the first run of a session (or a loaded CI runner) converts pure measurement noise into a hard gate failure. False failures train agents to re-run gates until green and erode trust in the pipeline — the symmetric hazard to the false-pass erosion pm-k6t4yb registers. Duplicate check: searched import-cost/noise/cold/flake all-status; pm-38bskj (closed) shaped the entrypoints, pm-ag9nka owns --profile truthfulness, pm-k6t4yb owns the gate registry and negative controls — none own per-run sampling noise of this gate. Fix directions (implementation out of scope for the filing pass): warm-up sample discarded before measurement, min-of-N sampling per entrypoint instead of single-shot, or cache-aware margin; whichever lands must register in the pm-k6t4yb gate registry with a negative-control fixture.

The import-cost gate cannot fail solely because the first sampled process hit a cold cache: measurement uses either a discarded warm-up sample or min-of-N per entrypoint; a simulated cold-cache run is green when costs are within budget; the gate still fails on a genuinely over-budget entrypoint (negative control per pm-k6t4yb); budgets in scripts/bench/sdk-entrypoint-budgets.json are not raised to absorb noise
pnpm lint is deterministic green on main regardless of filesystem cache warmth when entrypoint costs are within budget
First cold run failed at 545ms > 510ms on ./sdk/runtime; immediate warm re-runs pass unchanged
